name: stacking-words
title: Stacking Words
description: Splits text into lines and slides each line's words in from the right on scroll. Framework-agnostic Custom Element.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/stacking-words-element.ts";
---

<motion-stacking-words
  text="Every word arrives on its own."
  start="top 90%"
  end="top 30%"
></motion-stacking-words>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/stacking-words-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-stacking-words
    text="Every word arrives on its own."
    start="top 90%"
    end="top 30%"
  />
</template>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/stacking-words-element.js"></script>

<motion-stacking-words
  text="Every word arrives on its own."
  start="top 90%"
  end="top 30%"
></motion-stacking-words>

props.name: text
props.description: The text content to display and animate.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Scrub duration in seconds for smooth scroll linking.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between each word's animation in seconds.

props.name: scroll-element
props.description: CSS selector for scrollable container (defaults to window).
